claims: Artemis II mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida
Artemis II mission lifted off on April 1, 2026
Artemis II mission used Space Launch System (SLS) rocket
Space Launch System (SLS) rocket carried four astronauts on Artemis II mission
Artemis II mission is a 10-day trip around the moon
Artemis II mission marks the first crewed mission beyond low Earth orbit since 1972
Kennedy Space Center (KSC) is on Florida's Space Coast
Launch Complex 39B previously supported Apollo missions
Launch Complex 39B previously supported Skylab missions
Launch Complex 39B previously supported Space Shuttle missions
Artemis II launch was managed by NASA's Exploration Ground Systems
